definition: One verified emission to next; first99 intervals per 128-token request (63 for 105 smoke); pool interval means within hit/miss, not class-balanced throughput. Use starting emission verified guess to classify; next rank0 speculation overlaps rank1.
dependencies: hit=D+max(A+offset,B)+G; miss=max(D,R+C)+max(A+offset,B)+G. A=next rank0 speculation, B=rank1 target, C=corrected rank0, D=rank1 draft, R=restore.
